content: Nabii Yakub tee Witinaina Apinda i Tana Mesir
Sumaimo, abhosemo Israel tee sagala giu pewauana. Wakutuuna incia akawa i Bersyeba, incia apasombaakamo kurubani motosumbele i Aulataʼalana Ishak, o amana.
Kasiimpomo, afirimanimo Aulataʼala i Israel i nuncana pokamatana i malo, "Yakub, Yakub." Lawanina, "Sii iaku, Kawasana Opu."
Firimanina, "Iakumo Aulataʼala, Aulataʼalana amamu. Bholi umaeka ulingka i Mesir, roonamo Iaku bhekupamembaliko saangu lipu maoge iwe sumai.
Iaku bhekupoose tee ingkoo i Mesir, Iaku uka dhaanamo kubhawako umbuli pendua. Ingkoo bheupotidhole i saangoana Yusuf wakutuu ajalamu akawa."
Kasiimpomo, abhosemo Yakub minaaka i Bersyeba. Manga anana Israel abhawa amana, manga anana, manga bhawinena tee uka manga kareta ilambokona Firaun to aule manga incia.
Manga incia uka abhawa kadhambaakana tee harataa mopadhana ipokawaakana i Tana Kanaan, kasiimpo abhose i Mesir. Yakub abhawa bhari-bharia siwuluna, siitumo
bhari-bharia manga anana opuopuana umane tee bhawine.
O siimo manga sarona siwuluna Israel moumbana i Mesir, siitumo Yakub tee siwuluna.

content.text: siitumo Henokh, Palu, Hezron, tee Karmi.
siitumo Yemuel, Yamin, Ohad, Yakhin, Zohar, tee Saul, anana samia bhawinena Kanaan.
siitumo Er, Onan, Syela, Peres, tee Zerah. Maka Er tee Onan amatemo i Tana Kanaan.
siitumo Tola, Pua, Ayub, tee Simron.

content: Manga incia sii satotuuna siwuluna Lea, mopalaahirina manga anana umane to Yakub i Padan-Aram, tee uka Dina, anana bhawine. Jadi, bhari-bharia siwuluna Yakub minaaka i Lea, malape umane atawa bhawine, kabharina 33 mia.

content.text: siitumo Zifyon, Hagi, Syuni, Ezbon, Eri, Arodi, tee Areli.
siitumo Yimna, Yiswa, Yiswi, Beria, tee Sera, witinai bhawinena manga.

content: Manga incia sii satotuuna siwuluna Zilpa, bhatua bhawine idhawuakana Laban i Lea, o anana. Jadi bhari-bharia siwuluna Yakub mominaakana i Zilpa sumai kabharina 16 mia.
Manga anana Rahel, bhawinena Yakub:

content.text: siitumo Manasye tee Efraim, ipalaahirina i Mesir minaaka i Asnat binti Potifera, Imamu i On.
siitumo Bela, Bekher, Asybel, Gera, Naaman, Ehi, Ros, Mupim, Hupim, tee Ared.

content: Manga incia sii satotuuna siwuluna Yakub mominaakana i Rahel, kabharina 14 mia.

content.text: siitumo Yahzeel, Guni, Yezer, tee Syilem.

content: Manga incia sumai satotuuna siwuluna Bilha, bhatua bhawine idhawuakana Laban i Rahel, o anana. Jadi, bhari-bharia siwuluna Yakub mominaakana i Bilha kabharina pitu mia.
Kabharina mia moumbana i Mesir apobhawa tee Yakub, siitumo siwuluna, inda atolentu manga bhawinena, bhari-bharia 66 mia.
Manga anana Yusuf molaahirina to incia i Mesir dhaangia rua mia sabutuna bhari-bharia witinaina Yakub modhaangiana i Mesir wakutuu incia sumai kabharina 70 mia.
Yakub atumpumo Yuda aporikanaakea apokawaaka Yusuf to asusuakea dhala aporope i Tana Gosyen. Sakawana manga incia i Tana Gosyen,
Yusuf akompamo i karetana kasiimpomo alingka to apokawaaka Israel, amana, i Gosyen. Sapokawana manga, Yusuf asakumo bhorokona amana tee atangi amangenge i awaana.
Pogauna Israel i Yusuf, "Sii-sii taroakamo iaku kumate, roonamo iaku padhamo kukamata roumu tee kumataua ande ingkoo dhaangia udhadhi."
Kasiimpo Yusuf apogau i manga witinaina tee witinaina amana, "Iaku bhekulingka kupaumba Firaun, 'Manga witinaiku tee witinaina amaku, momboorena i Tana Kanaan, padhamo aumba iaku.
Manga incia sumai mojaganina kadhambaaka, roonamo manga incia amananeamo ajagani kadhambaaka. Gulumana bhembe dumba, gulumana sapi, tee sagala giu pewauana abhawea.'
Jadi, ande Firaun akemba ingkomiu tee aabha, 'Opea karajaamiu?'

Lawanimo, 'Apepuu maidhiidhi, sampemo sii-sii manga bhatuamu ajagani kadhambaaka, mboomo uka opuamami pitu lapina.' Tee mboo sumai ingkomiu amembali umboore i Tana Gosyen, roonamo bhari-bharia mojaganina kadhambaaka satotuuna kahina to miana Mesir."
